Panel 2: Close panel: foot pushes against cracked stone; a thin fissure of daylight opens, sea salt air and dust visible.

Panel 3: Large lower panel: stone shell bursts outward into fragments on exposed red-cliff summit. Golden monkey drops on hands/knees, coughing, no injuries yet. Broad ocean far beneath. Body animal fur, not human.

Panel 1: Small faded memory inset: laptop monitor, half-drunk water glass and vibrating phone on modern desk, no legible screen text, no people. Irregular soft border distinguishes memory.

  Text speaker=stone-monkey type=thought: "Của mình thật."

  Text speaker=stone-monkey type=thought: "Tôn Ngộ Không?""

  Text speaker=stone-monkey type=thought: "Trước hết phải tìm thác."
Panel 3: Tries sitting cross-legged on summit; tail trapped underneath buttocks, legs refuse balance; brows pinched. No magic aura.

Panel 4: Stands cautiously leaning forward with tail stretched backward; two tentative steps on flat stone.

Panel 5: Wide lower: goes down a natural rocky path into shade of green forest; golden fur catches last summit light.

Panel 2: Small: over-jumps into bush, leaves fly around face; no wound.

  Text speaker=stone-monkey type=speech: "Đá vỡ."

  Text speaker=stone-monkey type=speech: "Vừa ra khỏi đó."

Both golden and dark male approach top from uphill LEFT. Keep map for all rescue pages.
